lines.zh: 我摆着小鳍，一节一节往前蹭。
lines.en: Flicking my little fins, I inch forward.

lines.zh: 硬壳太重，我游得像块砖。
lines.en: My shell is heavy; I swim like a brick.

lines.zh: 尾巴一扇，身子只挪半寸。
lines.en: One tailbeat moves me half an inch.
I creep along the top of the reef.

lines.zh: 方形身子在水里晃得很笨。
lines.en: This boxy body wobbles clumsily in the water.
Turning takes me a wide, slow loop.
My small fins tick softly against the water.
I squeeze between branches of coral.

lines.zh: 水流推我，我偏要横着走。
lines.en: The current pushes me, but I go sideways.
My spots look like gravel on the bottom.

lines.zh: 我游过沙沟，影子方方的。
lines.en: I cross the sand trench, my shadow square.
Don't hurry me; this shell won't go faster.
Tilted to one side, I round the anemone.

lines.zh: 一路蹭着贝壳，壳上发亮。
lines.en: Nudging shells all the way, my shell shines.

lines.zh: 我侧过身子，才挤过这条缝。
lines.en: I turn sideways to squeeze through this gap.

lines.zh: 壳碰在珊瑚上，发出闷响。
lines.en: My shell knocks the coral with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我顺着一股缓流漂了一小段。
lines.en: I drift a short way on a slow current.

lines.zh: 前面有条大鱼，我赶紧贴底。
lines.en: A big fish ahead, so I drop to the bottom.

lines.zh: 我悬在珊瑚旁边，一动不动。
lines.en: I hover by the coral without moving.

lines.zh: 硬壳把我撑成一个方块。
lines.en: My hard shell holds me in a block.
My tiny mouth opens, closes, and blows a bubble.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙面，假装是石头。
lines.en: I lie on the sand pretending to be a stone.

lines.zh: 一条大鱼游过，我缩起鳍。
lines.en: A big fish passes and I tuck my fins.

lines.zh: 阳光把斑点照得很清楚。
lines.en: Sunlight makes my spots stand out.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让水从缝里过。
lines.en: I turn sideways to let water through my seams.
The shell is heavy, so I sink a little.
I count the shadows of coral branches.
The weeds are moving, not me.
I fold my fins against the shell rim.
Something taps on the outside of my shell.
I slowly level out and settle square.
The light in this corner is just right.
You sink down and I look up at you.

lines.zh: 你的面罩反光，晃到我了。
lines.en: Your mask flashes and dazzles me.
I stop beside your knee.
Your finger comes near and I shrink back.

lines.zh: 你这么高，怎么会在这里。
lines.en: You're so tall; why are you down here?

lines.zh: 我绕着你的腿游了半圈。
lines.en: I circle half around your leg.

lines.zh: 你呼气的水泡撞到我壳上。
lines.en: Your breath bubbles bump my shell.
I'm not afraid of you; my shell is just heavy.
Crouched on the bottom, you look like reef rock.

lines.zh: 你掌心里那点颜色，我看住了。
lines.en: That bit of colour in your palm holds my eye.

lines.zh: 壳上挨了一下，裂了条缝。
lines.en: Something hit my shell and split a seam.
The pain stiffens my fins.
My hard shell didn't stop that blow.
I turn turtle, belly upward.
Three points of health; not again.
Water seeps through the crack.
I curl up and my shell rim pales.
One knock dazes me; I can't swim.
My spots are smeared now.
The shell holds, but I've gone weak.
There's bait in your hand; I smell it.
I don't eat that stuff; stop waving it.
The bait smells too strong; I back away.

lines.zh: 我啃珊瑚上的小虫，不吃肉。
lines.en: I nibble coral bugs, not meat.

lines.zh: 你的手指动一下，我就转开。
lines.en: Your finger twitches and I turn away.

lines.zh: 那团东西软，我的嘴咬不动。
lines.en: That lump is soft; my mouth can't bite it.

lines.zh: 我绕着你手里转了两圈。
lines.en: I circle what you're holding twice.
I want it, but I fear tipping over.

lines.zh: 你把食物放下，我慢慢靠近。
lines.en: You set the food down and I edge closer.

lines.zh: 我小口试一下，又吐出来。
lines.en: I take a tiny bite and spit it out.
You touch me and my hard shell pushes back.

lines.zh: 我像块方石撞在你腿上。
lines.en: I hit your leg like a square stone.
My shell knocks hollow; it doesn't hurt.

lines.zh: 浪把我们挤在礁石缝里。
lines.en: The swell wedges us into a reef gap.
One nudge from you flips me halfway.

lines.zh: 我的边角很硬，小心你的手。
lines.en: My edges are hard; mind your hand.
After the bump I tilt, then slowly level.

lines.zh: 你踢到我，脚趾该疼的是你。
lines.en: You kick me; your toe is the one that hurts.
I slide along your swimsuit.
A bubble of yours is caught in my shell seam.

lines.zh: 水暖时，我和同伴并排游。
lines.en: When the water warms, my kin and I swim abreast.

lines.zh: 我们的壳碰一下，就算招呼。
lines.en: Our shells tap once, and that's hello.
I scatter eggs at the coral's base.

lines.zh: 方壳靠在一起，像两块砖。
lines.en: Our boxy shells lean together like bricks.

lines.zh: 我们的斑点深浅不一样。
lines.en: Our spots are different shades.

lines.zh: 小箱鲀一出来就是方的。
lines.en: The little ones come out square already.
I only hope the current spares the eggs.
My companion circles me slowly.

lines.zh: 我们各自游开，明年再见。
lines.en: We part ways; see you next season.
The eggs cling to the reef, quite secure.
I can't hold what you drop.

lines.zh: 一块壳沉下来，我推了推。
lines.en: A shell piece sinks; I nudge it.

lines.zh: 我的嘴太小，只有一粒沙大。
lines.en: My mouth is tiny, no bigger than a grain.

lines.zh: 它卡在珊瑚缝里，我进不去。
lines.en: It's stuck in coral and I can't get in.

lines.zh: 我绕着那东西转，没办法。
lines.en: I circle the thing with no idea what to do.
You dropped something shiny; I saw it.
I try to shove it and it won't move.

lines.zh: 箱子似的身子挡在它前面。
lines.en: My boxy body sits in front of it.

lines.zh: 我把它拨到沙坑里藏好。
lines.en: I sweep it into a sand pit and cover it.

lines.zh: 这东西不是吃的，我放开。
lines.en: This isn't food; I let it go.

lines.zh: 沙里钻出小虫，我看见了。
lines.en: A bug pokes out of the sand; I see it.
I turn my side toward that little stir.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼靠太近，我盯住。
lines.en: A small fish comes too close; I fix on it.
I let the quick go and pick the slow.
This shell is heavy, so one charge only.
I lock on the red shape under the coral.
Those weeds are moving; something's there.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，准备顶过去。
lines.en: I lower my head, ready to butt forward.
It flees, and I can't be bothered.
I fix on the crumbs drifting down.
I hover above that little bug.
My fins stop while I judge the distance.
It moves, and I adjust a little.
I aim my mouth at the sand.
My shell blocks part of my view.
It slips into a crack I can't enter.
I wait for it to come out a little more.
I turn to let the weeds pass.

lines.zh: 水波把它的位置抖花了。
lines.en: Ripples blur where it is.
Only one body length between us.

lines.zh: 我把方壳当锤子砸过去。
lines.en: I swing my box shell like a hammer.
A butt of my box shell shoves it away.

lines.zh: 我的力气只够撞歪小鱼。
lines.en: All my force can only tilt a small fish.

lines.zh: 这一下连沙都没扬起来。
lines.en: This hit doesn't even raise sand.
I scrape its flank with my hard edge.
My bump sends it sliding off.
I don't bite; I only butt with my shell.
I charge and flip myself over first.
My shell lands with a muffled thud.

lines.zh: 我这点劲，鲨鱼都懒得躲。
lines.en: I hit so weakly even sharks don't dodge.
I float out from under a coral branch.

lines.zh: 温暖浅海多了一只方影子。
lines.en: The warm shallows gain one square shadow.

lines.zh: 礁盘的沙窝里，我鼓着鳍。
lines.en: In a sand hollow on the reef, I puff my fins.
Only one of me arrives at a time.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋裂开，我落进水里。
lines.en: The egg cracks and I drop into the water.
When I was born my shell was still soft.

lines.zh: 浅海的阳光把我照得发亮。
lines.en: Shallow-water sun makes me glisten.

lines.zh: 我在珊瑚根边找到位置。
lines.en: I find a spot by the coral's roots.
The surface swell carries me down.
The water here is warm; I stay.
The water scalds and my shell pales.

lines.zh: 我摔在礁石上，壳响了一声。
lines.en: I hit the reef and my shell cracks loud.

lines.zh: 我被拖出水面，鳃贴着壳。
lines.en: Out of water, my gills stick to the shell.
The blast rolls my whole box over.
Something slips through my shell seam.
Cold force presses down on my shell.

lines.zh: 珊瑚上没小虫，我饿扁了。
lines.en: No tiny prey on the reef; I go flat.

lines.zh: 雷声过水，我壳里嗡嗡响。
lines.en: Thunder through water hums inside my shell.

lines.zh: 我掉出水面，方壳直往下坠。
lines.en: I fall from the water, box and all.
